items.label: 稀有
items.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE portrait collectible game card border STYLE PROPOSAL, transparent reusable empty overlay, 1024x1536. Inputs 1-3 are drawing-style references ONLY: hand-painted anime illustration, broad opaque directional strokes, coherent simplified masses, grouped colored shadows, sparse expressive tapered contours, confident handmade edges. Do not copy their people, clothes, text or watermarks. Adapt this painting grammar to the frame. Border should be light and slender, quiet enough to support anime card art. Its continuous structural edge is approximately 18-24 pixels thick, with a few local accents. Keep a large rectangular central opening, roughly x90..934, y130..1455; decorative forms may project outward, only slightly into the opening. Mostly muted colored grays with richer color concentrated in a few small accents; selective drawing rather than tiny textures. Matte painted 2D forms. Avoid heavy armor, beveled metal, shiny gems, glossy 3D, ornate European filigree, roses, vines, dense micro-detail, triangular facet mosaics and all-over grain. Actual alpha transparency throughout the interior and exterior; no opaque background, haze or backing sheet. No card artwork, character, text, number, cost icon or UI. All frame parts contained inside canvas.
THEME: A lightly torn matte paper-and-ink frame with an editorial anime sketchbook feel. Four narrow pale warm-gray paper strips form a simple rectangle, a few irregular torn contour breaks and visible blunt painted overlaps. Two small muted indigo-blue paper tape tabs hold the upper left and lower right corners. A confident asymmetrical cobalt brush swipe crosses only the upper border near the right side, another short stroke accents the lower left. A few charcoal-blue ink marks describe folds and edge turns. Corners feel casual, handcrafted and crisp. Paper strips are only the border, never a full page behind the opening. No large illustration or busy scribbles; keep sides mostly calm.
items.note: 蓝色对角胶带 · 宽笔扫痕

items.label: 史诗
items.detail: PURPLE, moderately ornate: TWO clearly visible offset layers of pale torn paper, the inner thin backing layer in muted lilac. FOUR distinct small purple tape patches, one at each corner, diagonally arranged, with the upper-left and lower-right patches overlapping a second short violet strip. A medium flat purple DIAMOND ink seal on a small paper tab at TOP CENTER (about 70px wide). One thin hand-painted violet bracket line along the top and bottom rails, two short curved ink flourishes by the seal, and two tiny folded lilac paper corner tips. More carefully articulated folds and tape overlaps than the input rare version. Side rails remain calm. Decoration covers about twice the accent area of rare, without widening the main paper rails.

Preserve the slender torn-paper foundation; add decoration by layering along the paper edges and projecting into the outside margin, never obstruct the inner card aperture. No beveled metal, armor, stone, gemstone, glossy 3D or photoreal texture; this is illustration of crafted paper, tapes, pigment, stamps and flat ribbon bookmarks. No baked glow; application handles animated light.

items.label: 传说
items.detail: GOLDEN OCHRE, richly designed: THREE offset paper layers: warm ivory main rails, a visible slim cream underlayer and a ochre-tinted backing layer. FOUR ornate but FLAT illustrated paper corner assemblies, each composed of a gold tape patch, small fan-folded paper corner and a short curved matte golden pigment accent. TOP CENTER has a prominent stamped SUN-WHEEL medallion on a round ivory paper seal, about 100px across, with a tiny ochre ribbon tab hanging OUTSIDE the rail. BOTTOM CENTER echoes it with a smaller diamond paper seal. Thin carefully drawn ochre ink double-rules run over much of the top and bottom rails, and one short rhythmic line-and-dot flourish appears at each side midpoint. More selected fine contour accents and clearer crafted folds than epic, with quiet areas between decoration clusters. Gold is matte paint and ink, never metal. Visibly richer silhouette and stronger central crest hierarchy than epic.

items.label: 棱彩
items.detail: PASTEL CYAN/PINK/LILAC, the MOST elaborately designed tier: FOUR visible staggered paper/vellum layers around the same fixed aperture, with warm white main rails and slim pale cyan, lavender and blush offset edges. Each of FOUR CORNERS has TWO overlapping differently colored tape tabs and a carefully folded pointed paper accent, giving eight tape pieces in total. TOP CENTER has a prominent FOUR-POINT STAR paper crest about 115px across, layered in white, lilac and pale cyan with smaller flat stamped star shapes to either side. BOTTOM CENTER echoes with a smaller layered geometric star seal and two short thin outward-facing ribbon bookmarks. Add elegant sparse CONSTELLATION INK linework: three tiny connected dots per side, a little diamond at each side midpoint, and a thin three-color broken rule on the upper and lower rails. Most refined selected drawing and color layering of the series, with crisp small paper folds and expressive broad pigment strokes remaining. Multicolor accents distributed across all four sides make the rarity unmistakable at thumbnail scale. No sparkly particle cloud, no shiny foil or neon, no glow baked in. Preserve calm aperture and legible broad forms.

This stamp lies on the paper/tape area and doesn't obstruct the aperture.
